purpose: Denominators for the price per head shown on Ledger tooltips (PLAN_V07 Phase 1, finding H18).

sources.name: Wikidata Query Service (population, P1082, point in time 2020-04-01)
U.S. Census 2020 county populations as carried in data/staging/faith-altar.json (population_2020)

gate: The Census API (api.census.gov) now answers every query with a redirect to missing_key.html: it requires an API key in the URL, which this environment does not hold. Wikidata's 2020-04-01 statements are the 2020 Census counts, cited per item (QID in each row).
selection: Included only Ledger entries where the money was taken from the residents' own general-purpose government (city, town, village, county). Excluded entries and reasons are listed in the staging file. Addison, NY is the village (the clerk-treasurer served the village), not the surrounding town.
caveats: 2020 population is a common yardstick; the thefts span 1980s-2020s and populations moved.
Amounts are court-recorded totals; some schemes ran for decades.
A per-resident figure is arithmetic, not a measure of harm.
verdict: H18 REJECTED as a size contrast (1.9x < 5x); per-resident figures ship on tooltips.
